hints.title: Standard Conversion Formulas
hints.text: Kelvin is obtained by adding 273.15 to Celsius.

hints.title: Fahrenheit Formula
hints.text: Fahrenheit is computed by multiplying Celsius by 1.80 and adding 32.00.

hints.title: Array Aggregation
hints.text: Return the two converted values in a two-element floating point array.

hints.title: Direct Arithmetic Conversion Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct floating-point arithmetic evaluated in constant time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory for returning the two-element pair.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard arithmetic formulas with floating-point precision.
